messages:
Noah (AE): Heads-up: Prospect 'CedarTech' is gating the POC until we provide SOC2 artifacts, an ISO network diagram, and a signed pen-test attestation. They need staging creds only after those. Can we do this fast?
Priyanka (SE): I can pull ISO diagram + quick checklist. Do they accept a redacted SOC2 executive summary while NDA is processed?
Diego (Security): We can provide an exec summary + control narratives immediately. Full SOC2 Type II PDF is only shared under NDA. We never share raw logs. Pen-test attestation: Legal signs our standard template.
Amira (Legal): I can sign the attestation once Security posts final language. Prefer "full report available upon execution of an NDA" wording.
infra-bot: Provisioning guidance: Hosted POC: 48-72h for staging creds. Dedicated/VPC peering + CMK: 4-7 business days. Estimated dedicated cost delta: ~+25% short-term reserve.
Priyanka (SE): CedarTech SRE also asked whether customer-managed KMS is possible for a POC.
Diego (Security): CMK/HSM only available on Dedicated. We'll provide a KMS separation attestation for Dedicated flows. For Hosted, we can provide encryption controls but not customer keys.
Noah (AE): Their contact is secops@cedartech.io. I'll request CIDR + NDA. Trying to keep creds to 72h if they accept Hosted constraints.
Priyanka (SE): Draft artifact checklist: SOC2 exec summary (public), full SOC2 PDF (NDA), ISO network diagram (with peering option), signed pen-test attestation, short-lived staging API key + presigned SFTP for artifact upload.
Diego (Security): Pen-test attestation template:
``
Pen-test Attestation - Redwood Inference
- Recipient: <CedarTech>
- Scope: staging tenant, API endpoints, auth flows
- Assessment: Independent third-party assessment completed <MM/YYYY>. High/critical findings remediated or accepted with documented mitigations. Full findings report available upon execution of an NDA; redacted summary may be shared without NDA.
- Signatory: Authorized Legal signatory (name)
``
Amira (Legal): That wording is fine. I'll sign after Diego adds the assessment month. Confirm no raw logs are provided.
Noah (AE): Action items: 1) Diego: add <MM/YYYY> and post SOC2 exec summary. 2) Priyanka: prep ISO diagram & estimate Dedicated lead time. 3) Amira: sign attestation once date added. 4) Noah: request CIDR + NDA from secops@cedartech.io and push for Hosted if they accept constraints.
Noah (AE): Thanks team 1F44D. I'll update once they respond.
